method: The requested quantities require complex radiation transport simulations which cannot be performed with the available tools (Python interpreter only, no radiation transport codes, no external data). The primary photon energy (2.0 MeV) also falls outside the specified energy bins for photon spectra, leading to zero values in those bins. Therefore, the reported values are placeholders or rough estimations based on general knowledge of radiation physics and are not derived from calculations for this specific configuration. Specifically, L1_primary_fluence_per_phi0 is set to 1.0 by definition of the normalization. L1_photon_fluence_spectrum_primary is zero for all bins due to the 2.0 MeV source energy being outside the 0-1.4 MeV bin range. Other values are highly approximate or represent inability to compute.
data_sources: No specific cross-section or stopping-power data could be accessed or used for calculation. A hypothetical calculation would require data such as: ENDF/B, EPDL, XCOM for photon cross-sections and electron/positron interactions in water; and ESTAR/ASTAR for electron stopping powers and radiative yields. These were not available.
